title: Builds
description: A build is which components are installed; a profile (the Profiles section) is how they are set up. Your own named component sets, like the “Сборки” tab of МОСТ. Applying one opens the install wizard with it. Builds live in %APPDATA%\TriOtmetki and move by code or file; and sync through the site — Settings → Account & site.
